batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b KA Pollard

batting.name: DH Yagnik
batting.dismissal: c SR Tendulkar b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c SK Trivedi b A Chandila

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c BJ Hodge b JP Faulkner

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c SR Watson b SK Trivedi

batting.name: R Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c JP Faulkner b STR Binny

balls.text: inside out from Rahane, carved over the cover region for a four! Good shot to end the innings, good over as well, with 19 coming from it!
slower one, outside the off stump, wanted to tap it through to third-man but beaten by the slowness of the pace
and another one now! this is bad bowling from Mitchell, it's length bowling and swung across the line for a four, over mid-wicket for another boundary
and now it's the turn of Rahane! it was fuller, straighter and Rahane's forced it over extra-cover for a four, getting some late runs here
and this time was opening his stance up and was looking to play it over the off side, gets a bit of an inside edge, they run throught for a single
and wow! where was Hodge all this while, it was a short of length ball and he goes across the line, smacks it over deep square-leg for a six!
down the leg side, very full, yorker length and Rahane was walking towards the off side, beats the leg stump but not called a wide
up in the air and that's a drop! it beat Rahane there, the ball scooped high up in the air and falls between Malinga and Tendulkar! Both could have caught it and both didn't get a hand!
and another very good delivery, pitched right up to the bat, driven down the ground for a single
full-toss and flicked between long-on and mid-wicket for a couple more for Hodge
a very full ball and on the stumps, Rahane was looking to flick it away, gets hit on his pads, just another single
fuller on the off stump and driven down the ground for a single
finally a four, will be a relief for the Royals and for Rahane, was fuller and quicker and he reverse sweeps it through short third-man for a four
another one tapped to the off side and another stroking shot which is only a single
punched down the ground to get to his 7th IPL 50, single again
shorter this time and cut away to the deep cover region for a single
and again, Rahane's doing his best to get some away but he's just not getting them off the middle, inside edged to the leg side
was shaping to slog it away but had to adjust his shot when he saw it was not in the slot, nudged to the leg side for a single
very full from the offie and driven to the off side for a single
and at the other end Rahane continues to pick the singles, played away to the leg side
shorter, quicker, tapped down the ground for a single
quicker one but down the leg-side and it's a wide this time
slogged it away and for a six! that's an excellent shot from Hodge after all those overs of not too many, went for one on the length
quicker from Harbhajan and Rahane is only able to hit it to long-off for a single
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it to short third-man for a single
slower and flighted from Ojha, defended to the leg side by Hodge, away for a quick single
driven down the ground and they are able to come back for a second run to Rishi Dhawan at long-off
another shimmy down the pitch but he's struggling to get them away is Rahane, pushed to the extra-cover region for a single
defended to a delivery from Ojha to the off side and they are away for a quick single
short of length from Ojha and easily played it away to long-on for a single

and Rahane was trying to go down again, gets an inside edge and there's an appeal for a run-out! out, the batsman's out by a yard, they were going for the second to Johnson's arm, he came in quickly and lets it loose at the non-striker's end where Ojha gathers it well and whips the bails away, Binny's gone!
opens the face of the bat and guides it to the third-man region where they should have gotten themselves a single, instead they rush back for a second. Harbhajan fails to get it back in time...
wanted to go after it but the drive doesn't materialise, fails to get any bat on it
and now he opens the face of the bat, tapped away for a single
outside the off stump, and that's almost caught! There was one fielder running out from the inside the circle and another coming from outside, none of them got close
better from Johnson, outside the off and he taps it away to the point fielder, quickly runs across for a single
starts off with a wide, from round the stumps and angling down the leg-side, Rahane fails to get any bat on it
quickly on to the back foot and tucked it away to the leg side for a single
fuller and driven down the ground for a single

gone, caught, off a reverse sweep! Yagnik was looking to go after Harbhajan after those early dots this over, the ball seems to have bounced more than he expected and the top-edge goes to fine-leg where Tendulkar almost seemed to have lost the ball, grabs it in the end.
he's quickly down the track yet again and pushes it over to long-off for a single
now tries to go down the track but Harbhajan sees that early and drags it short, defended back to the bowler
slower from Harbhajan and that's defended on the front foot by the Rajasthan opener
a very full length ball and beats the inside edge of the bat, there's a bit of appeal for lbw but seemed to be going down the leg stump
fullish delivery and driven through the covers for a single
another slower one and Yagnik has stopped slogging them like it's a conscious decision to do that against Malinga, taps it away to the off side
slower from Malinga and easily played down to fine-leg for a single to bring up a 33-ball 50 run stand
full-toss on the off stump and driven through the covers for a single
short of length from Malinga and it's easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, widish too and he was trying to cut it away, misses, through to the keeper
slogged away again! that wasn't as well timed as the others and it lands in no-man's land, for a couple of runs to mid-wicket
short of length and flicked away to the leg side for a single
slower ball and he was walking down the track to smack it over, missed by the batsman
clears his foot, slogs it away, gets it only as far as Ponting as mid-wicket, who drops it but more vitally it's another no-ball
short one, bouncer in fact, and he wanted to pull it away, hits his helmet I think, but wait, it's a no-ball, so that's going to be a Free Hit
very short there and that's cut away to the deep point region for a four! this is excellent batting from the keeper!
down the leg side and that's a wide, getting a tad rattled here
easily pushed away to the fine-leg for a couple of runs, well tucked away, well run too
slower from Harbhajan and well defended on the front foot from Rahane, ends the over which went for 8.
opens the face of the bat and guides it to the short third-man fielder, off for a quick single
slogged away to the deep square-leg for a four! that was fuller from Harbhajan and smashes it away to the fence for a four
fuller this time but Rahane easily works it away to the leg side for a single
short of length from the spinner again and easily tapped away to the leg side for a single
shortish in length from Harbhajan and Rahane cuts it to the deep point region for a single
shot sir! that was full and it's drilled over the point fielder for a four, 16 from that over for RR!
short of length and tapped to the off side for no run, that could have been spanked away but did not get too much on it
goes after Pollard, timed exceptionally well but it was in the slot, and Yagnik slogged it over mid-wicket for a six!
short of length, and opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
down the leg side and going further down, called wide
goes wide on the crease and gets it to come back into the batsman, taps it to the leg side
slower from Pollard and that's cut rather well, should have been stopped by Malinga at deep point who dives over it
quicker and shorter, wanted to cut it away, misses
slowing it down well and there are a few which are turning, like this one, and Yagnik tries to tap and run, sent back by Rahane
short of length and easily worked away to the leg side for a single
tries to work it over the mid-wicket, gets it away for a single
slower from Harbhajan from round the stumps, turn away from the batsman and it rolls over to the off side
short of length, cuts away to the deep cover for a single
and now chipped over the in-field for a couple of runs to mid-wicket

leading edge and it goes off for the second such boundary! it was from round the stumps and the left-hander was looking to flick it to the leg side, but the edge flies through point and beats the third-man fielder
outside the off, short of length and cut it away, but straight to the point fielder
down the leg side and goes further down for a wide
fuller ball from Pollard and driven back to the bowler, well fielded to his right

edged and taken! Watson's gone, caught! this was brought from way behind the umpire, it was outside the off stump and Watson was trying to cut it hard through the covers for a four, instead gets an outside edge there and Karthik does the rest.
on his pads and gently tapped away to short fine-leg for a single
shorter in length and quicker too, goes on to the back foot and flicks it away for a run
short and wide, the turn made it difficult for Watson, and gets a bit of a bottom edge
fuller from Ojha and defended on the front foot back to the bowler
slower from Ojha, on his pads, bit of turn, tapped to the leg side, bit of hesitation about the running
short of length, he's quickly on to the back foot and cut away to the deep covers for a single
fuller and defended on the front foot, back to the bowler
and a better one to end the over, short of length and has Watson hopping, beats the outside edge of the bat through to the keeper
bludgeoned! four! shot! that's fuller from Malinga and has that been spanked or what! drilled through mid-off for a four, not a soul moved except those in the stands.
on his pads, was trying to york him but had a very poor line going for him, hits his pads and rolls over to the fence
and again, this time he does not get hold of the shot, hits the bottom of the bat but he still has enough power to clear mid-on and get himself a four, was a short of length ball too
goes over the top and for a four! that's pitched up to the bat this time from Malinga and Watson's gone after him, smashes it over mid-off for a four
short of length, outside the off stump and Watson has a dart at it, misses the outside edge

down the track and middles it well, gets a maximum! It was not really flighted but Rahane had made up his mind to go after him and he almost had to reach out for it, not a problem for the 'Mumbai' player Rahane!
quicker and shorter, easily worked away to square-leg for a single
slightly shorter on the off stump and cuts it to the fielder at point
top-edge and over the short fine-leg fielder for a four! that was way down the leg side and Watson shuffled across and slog swept it over the fielder
drifts on to his pads again and Rahane is able to flick it away for a single to short fine-leg
flatter from round the stumps and Watson gets bit of a bat on it, rolls over to short fine-leg for a single
another one that's slightly shorter and Rahane wants to punch it through but can get it out only to a fielder, no run
short of length from Dhawan and Rahane pushes it to back to the bowler
extra bounce for Dhawan and Watson's had to fend it away to the leg side, gets a single to the leg side
this time he's got it out of the middle, shorter from Dhawan and Watson's not missing out of that one, spanking shot over mid-wicket for a six!
short of length and it bounces more than he expected by it, fails to put it away as it goes straight to Pollard again
in-dipper and Watson was almost surprised by that one, gets an inside edge on to the pads
good thinking from Johnson after all those shortish deliveries, he gets one to pitch up but Rahane is up to the task and is able to turn it away to the leg side for a couple of runs
defended on the back foot to mid-off

inside edge and four! that's a streaky shot to get a four, it was short of length too but kept a tad lower than what the batsman expected and takes the bottom of the bat, beats the keeper and runs away
better this time, opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
and he goes for it again, this time it's beaten! It was fuller on the off stump and Watson was looking to smoke it over the long-on region...misses
edged and through the slips cordon for a four! it was a widish ball from MJ and Watson goes hard at it, despite the presence of two slips there it flies away to the fence
bouncer from Malinga and pulled away to the mid-wicket fence for a four! second one of the over...
fuller from Malinga and driven to the off side, there's that big man Pollard who swoops on the ball at point
short of length this time but a lot closer to the batsman, defended it back to the bowler's right
and again, like the first delivery, there was a bit of swing away from the bat and Rahane taps it to the backward point region
punches a good length ball from Malinga and through the covers for a four! it was only a push but Malinga's pace was quite helpful there
outside the off stump, and swings further away from Lasith Malinga, he was trying fiddle at it, almost sucked into playing at it, beaten
big appeal for an lbw there, it was fuller this time unlike the previous deliveries which were a tad short and hits smack in the middle of the Watson pads, sliding down probably
whoa, what a ball! it was a bouncer and it was almost in that blind area, cramping him for room and Watson was looking to fend it away, hits the handle of his bat I think and rolls behind
quickish delivery but a good in-swinging ball too, on a good line and length and Watson has to quickly bring his bat down to defend
shortish yet again, he was looking to leave it this time but in the end dabs it away to backward point where Pollard dives to his left to stop it
down the leg side, there was a little swing for Johnson but started from around the middle-stump line, wide called
short of length ball and on the middle stump, Rahane's on his back foot and defends it to the off side
on his pads and Watson works it away down to fine-leg for a single
...but this time he's gone, on the stumps and Malinga misses, the leg stump is sent cartwheeling and Rajasthan have won the most comfortable of games here
inside edge and that's run away to the fence for a four! it was on a good length and Malinga was playing without moving his feet, no luck for the bowler
down the leg side and it was another slow ball, Malinga fails to get a bat on that, wide called
a very slow one from Cooper and Malinga could have played his shot twice, misses, through on the second or third bounce to the keeper
fuller from Copper and Malinga drives it through the covers for a couple of runs to get off the mark
outside the off stump, fuller too and wants to spank it away, misses the outside egde
short of length and tucked away to the leg side, off for a quick single too but Cooper quickly gets to it and tries to run him out at the non-striker's end, misses
and now Cooper gets a late wicket, he was walking across the stumps and is trapped in front is Rayadu, and the ump has his finger raised
defended on the leg side, he wanted a single but was sent back.
that's cut but not hard enough and falls just short of the point fielder
down the leg side and gets a bit of pad on that one, caught by the keeper but it wasn't off the bat.
another back of the hand slower one, gets an inside edge through to the keeper
slower one from Faulker and pushed to the off side
fuller, straighter, was looking to play it across the line and is beaten, gets an inside edge, on to the pads and then, from there on to the stumps, the bails are down and so are the Mumbai Indians
tries for a yorker again and turns into a full-toss thats drilled to the leg side for a single
and another four, he was trying to pull it away, gets bit of an under-edge but still beats the deep square-leg fielder and goes to the fence
down the pitch to a full-toss and drilled to long-off for a single
shorter one from Cooper, and he was trying to cut it, gets an edge that falls in front of Hodge at short third-man, beats him and goes for a four
slower ball from Cooper and it was flicked away by Johnson, again the ball never came on to the bat and he did not entirely go through the shot
fuller from Cooper and driven down the ground for a single

the fine-leg was pushed back and he bowls one very short, looking to hook it away but the lack of pace makes it difficult for the batsman, runs away in the gap between deep square-leg and fine-leg but only for a couple
another shorter one from Sid Trivedi and it's pulled in front of square for a single
four for Mitch, was short of length and it was a short arm jab from him, earns himself a boundary
a very slower one, Johnson looked to be winding up for a big blow but had to check his shot in the end
keeps slightly low this one, was playing off the back foot and gets it off the toe end of the bat there
on a good length and a bit of swing away from the bat, gets an outside edge and it gets them a single to the off side
inside edge now and it has not carried through to the keeper, wow, some more swing!

gone now, run-out, don't know though! that's gone, one of them is gone, flicked away to the leg side by Rayadu and he was off for a single, Harbhajan was never interested and both the batsmen were at the same end! Both were at hand-shaking distance from each other although at that stage it seemed like they wanted to do anything but shake hands, in the end the third umpire has to intervene and send Harbhajan on his way!
and some swing! wow! it's the 14th over of the innings, and while it is one thing to have a slow pitch, it's quite another to see one that swings too! beats the outside edge
fuller from Binny and a tentative-looking Harbhajan punches it down the ground for a single
taken at short mid-wicket! end of Dhawan! that was fuller and he was trying to flick it away there, gets beaten by the lack of pace and is easily caught by Faulkner there, six down for almost nothing
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
tapped to the off side and for a single, takes Rayadu on to 17 as ends an over that costs 5
he continues to go down the track, but misses the outside edge, not getting anything off the middle of the bat here
end of Karthik, caught at long-on! that was a painfully slow innings from Karthik, a fighting one all the same and it's finally ended with a shot to long-on that goes to hand.
tries to go over the top and the outside edge rushes to the deep point fielder, the fielder had a long run inside and they are able to come back for the second
very full from the bowler and driven to the off side for a single, bit of a misfield from Cooper there
slower one from the bowler, tapped away to the off side for a single
and opens the face of the bat yet again to guide it to the third-man fielder for a single
fuller and driven down the ground for a single, not getting the boundaries with the required rate at 15 now
slower one from Cooper and that's dabbed away gently to the leg side for a single
opens the face of the bat, gets it to third-man for a couple of runs, fielded well by Hodge there
fuller on the off stump and driven through the covers for a single
short of length and cut away to the third-man region for a couple of runs
some respite, a slower one and this time Karthik was waiting for it, flicks it over square-leg for a four!
another slower one from Trivedi, and Karthik was trying to hook him away, gets nothing, just rolls over to the off side
again down the pitch but not off the middle of the bat, not able to get them away too easily here, single to long-on
short of a length ball and was looking to hook it away over the fine-leg region, does not get any bat on it although a wide's not given so could have hit something
almost! a run-out chance there! it was tapped to the off side and Karthik was running down the pitch from the non-striker's end, was sent back and luckily for him the throw does not hit!
short of a length and a slower one, wanted to pull it away but gets it down to long-on for a single
goes down the track and wants to cut hard, gets it away too but Rahane dives and fields well, restricts it to a single
and beaten again, outside the off stump, was looking to open the face of the bat but does not get any bat on it
another single to the off side which takes the required rate up to almost 13.5
slip in place now as the batsman drives it through the covers for a single, was much fuller this time
outside the off stump and lets it go through to the keeper
short of length from the bowler and still cannot get it away, straight to the fielder
short of length now, he was going down the pitch but he can only tap it to the leg side, given a run
on the middle stump and tapped to the leg side, not getting too many off the middle of the bat, the pitch seems to have gotten really slow
almost squares him up, could have got a leading edge but it goes straight back to mid-off
on the middle stump and tapped away to the leg side by Rayadu, that's played well and run equally well, couple of runs for the batsman
on his pads now and Karthik's feeling the pinch here, should have been flicked away, but hits his pad only
defended on the front foot and back to the bowler
edged and gone for four! there should have been a slip but there isn't and that's run away pretty quickly!

bowled him now, Pollard's bowled and Mumbai are in trouble or what! it was a straighter one from Binny and there was a bit of swing there from the bowler, the ball through and Pollard's middle stump has been pegged back!
width from Binny and Karthik looks to cut it away, gets it away to third-man for a single
pushed down the ground now for a single, signs of the ball not coming on to the bat
and now a shorter one from Binny which is pulled away to the deep square-leg for a single
pushed to the off side for a couple of runs to the off side
and again, would you believe it, it's a maiden, Trivedi's got a wicket first ball and bowled five really good deliveries at Pollard, who defends the last one too
on the back foot and defended back to the bowler again
and again, on the back foot, some movement away and Pollard's only defending it to the off side, he will look to settle down here
short of length, on to the back foot and defended to the off side by Pollard
oooh, and now some swing! Pollard's at five and he was looking to defend it, the ball swings away from the batsman, beats his outside edge!

gone, caught, Trivedi gets a wicket first ball! that was a normal delivery, nothing to write home about and he was looking to pull it over the mid-wicket fielder, instead gets it high on the bat and straight to the fielder, it looked like the ball did not come on to the bat.
and now the cut, just goes straight to the cover fielder where Hodge's present
defended on the front foot and goes off to the covers, not for runs
arm ball, quicker on his pads, flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single
shorter in length and defended on the back foot
whoa, gets it to spin and beats the outside edge, the track's helping the slower bowlers here
fuller and wants to sweep it away, does not get it away too far away from the bat
not too quick, on the off stump and punched to the off side, straight into the covers though
another slower one, wanted to cut it away, but can only get it to third-man for a single
was walking down the track, Faulkner tried to cramp him for room but ends up bowling it down the leg side
opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single, gets off the mark with that too
a very slower ball, Karthik was looking to pull it away but the ball never arrived, hits him and they run across for a leg-bye
outside the off, on a length, and defended to the off side
shot from Karthik and goes for a four! it was pitched right up to the bat and the batsman goes over the bowler's head, very, very straight and for a four!
flicked away to the leg side for a single now to end the over
goes down the track and smashes it over the mid-on fielder for a four! finally a shot in anger that has the desired result for the batsman!
quicker this time, looking to turn it away from the leg side, does not get any bat on it
down the leg side and wanted to sweep it away, misses but luckily it's a wide
another one that's on his pads and he struggles to get it away, bit of an inside edge or else could have been lbw
turn away from the batsman, he was looking to defend and misses the outside edge
fuller from Chavan and defended to the leg side
defends a good length ball back to the bowler

and he's gone now, Ponting's gone, caught and bowled! this is excellent stuff from the Royals, and from Chandila, the batsman was struggling throughout against him and this time he lobs up a simple catch back to the bowler, easily taken and Mumbai Indians are two down very quickly!
and another one, that's another short one from Chandila but they are not able to time it away, only a single to long-on
very short from the bowler and pulled away to the leg side for a single
fullish from Chandila and easily played down to long-on for a single
pushed to the off side and this time they are away for a quickly taken run
very short from Chavan and he wanted to pull it away to the leg side, misses and there's a bit of an appeal, was missing the stumps
slightly shorter and flicked away to the leg side, straight to square-leg
was a quicker one as Ponting looks to go on to the front foot, the ball flies off the inside edge to the leg side
shorter this time and cut away, but straight to the cover fielder
in the air and it lands between the bowler and mid-on, almost a wicket!
on his pads and flicked away to the leg side for a single
another one that's perfect in terms of line and length, pushed to the off side
was looking to play off the back foot and the extra bounce makes hims take his bottom hand off, defended back
top-edged and out! Tendulkar was looking to sweep it across the line and the extra bounce gets the better of the sweep, it goes high in the air and Trivedi at short fine-leg takes an easy catch there
on the middle stump but spinning down the leg side, hits the pad and rolls down to fine-leg for a couple of leg-byes
pushed down to deep mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark too now Ponting
fuller and driven down the ground for a single, long-on in place for Tendulkar
